Prowlarr.description:
Prowlarr is an indexer manager and proxy that integrates torrent trackers and Usenet indexers with Sonarr, Radarr and others. See the quick-start guide for setup information.

Note: If you will use Prowlarr with FlareSolverr, Sonarr and Radarr, then make sure all of them are in the same Docker network after installation.

Based on a custom OCI image, available for amd64 and arm64 architecture. Rockstor V5.5.0 or later.
